$comment: Only the keys below are merged into ~/.claude/settings.json. Everything else in that file
is left untouched, including env.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS which holds a plaintext API key.
Hook entries are appended alongside existing ones (rtk, notify-stop), never replacing them.
$comment-skillOverrides: Claude Code ships ~40 skills compiled into its own binary, and an Anthropic-managed plugin adds
~11 more. None of those exist on disk, so 75 names are reachable -- not the 24 in ~/.agents/skills.
These entries either collide with something here on nearly identical triggers, or spend listing
budget on work outside the development loop.
'name-only' keeps the skill listed and still invocable but drops the description -- the part that
competes for auto-invocation. 'off' hides it from both the model and the menu.
Nothing here targets our own skills. Those live in Cursor too, and this file does not, so hiding
one here would make the two agents disagree; ours are managed by frontmatter instead. Bundled and
plugin skills do not exist in Cursor at all, so there is nothing to diverge from.
disableBundledSkills is deliberately NOT used: it drops all ~40 at once, including code-review and
review which the usage log shows in real use, and it exists only in CLI 2.1.219+ -- an older
`claude` on $PATH ignores it silently. See docs/adr/0006.
